en: A black-and-white postcard image depicting a traditional German mill building surrounded by dense trees and natural landscape. The building has the words 'Volkspark Buschmühle' written on its side. There are a few people visible near the base of the building, suggesting it is a public or visitor-friendly site. The overall style and print quality suggest an older period, possibly mid-20th century.
